name: swift-written-tools-chapters-vtt
description: The Rust engine executes a chapter-marker export (VTT) that the Swift engine previewed and recorded, then undoes it; the video is never modified. Seeded from the catalog the Swift engine wrote.

name: swift-written-tools-photo-jpeg
description: The Rust engine executes a JPEG photo export that the Swift engine previewed and recorded, lists it in its history and undoes it; the source is never modified. Seeded from the catalog the Swift engine wrote.

steps.label: no catalog assets
steps.db: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_assets

name: swift-written-tools-photo-png-enlarge
description: The Rust engine executes a PNG photo export with upscaling that the Swift engine previewed and recorded, lists it in its history and undoes it; the source is never modified. Seeded from the catalog the Swift engine wrote.

steps.label: no catalog assets
steps.db: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_assets

name: swift-written-video-fit
description: The app-hosted Rust engine executes a 1:1 fit video export that the Swift engine previewed and recorded, then undoes it; the source is never modified. Seeded from the catalog the Swift engine wrote.

name: swift-written-media-rotate
description: The app-hosted Rust engine executes a 90 degree rotation that the Swift engine previewed and recorded, then undoes it; the source is never modified. Seeded from the catalog the Swift engine wrote.

name: swift-written-media-trim
description: The app-hosted Rust engine executes a keyframe trim that the Swift engine previewed and recorded, then undoes it; the source is never modified. Seeded from the catalog the Swift engine wrote.

name: swift-written-catalog-chapter-edit
description: A chapter the Swift engine saved is found by Rust evidence search, edited by Rust and restored by Rust Undo, while face provenance, refresh failures and corrections the Swift-written catalog holds survive.

steps.label: rust first hit is the chapter
person name
steps.db: SELECT name FROM persons WHERE id=7

steps.label: refresh failure
steps.db: SELECT embedding_model,processing_version,attempts,retry_after,reason FROM face_refresh_failures WHERE face_id=4

steps.label: face provenance
steps.db: SELECT person_id,embedding_model,processing_version,source_revision,length(arcface_embedding) FROM face_prints WHERE id=4

steps.label: user correction
steps.db: SELECT region_json,user_edited,stale FROM catalog_observations WHERE id='faceprint:4'

steps.label: face embedding projection
steps.db: SELECT model,dimension,hex(vector)=hex((SELECT arcface_embedding FROM face_prints WHERE id=4)) FROM catalog_embeddings WHERE entity_id='faceprint:4'

name: swift-written-chat-history
description: A conversation the Swift engine stored is read by Rust: history persists, contextual media follow-ups resolve against the earlier subject, clear deletes it, and source files are never touched.

steps.label: chat deleted
steps.db: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_chat),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM files)

name: swift-written-takes-grouping
description: Related-take proposals written by the Swift job are current for the Rust job: session keys and file fingerprints match byte for byte, so an unchanged rerun redoes nothing and Rust reads the same groups.

steps.label: rust redid nothing
steps.db: SELECT group_key,session,relation,file_ids_json,evidence_json,proposed_at FROM take_proposals ORDER BY group_key

steps.label: rust keeps the fingerprints
steps.db: SELECT file_id,session,fingerprint FROM take_proposal_files ORDER BY file_id

name: swift-written-names-learned-style
description: Smart-name style samples the Swift engine recorded are read by Rust: it adds a third sample, derives the same preferences, applies them to a name and resets them.

name: swift-written-trash-journal-imported
description: A Trash batch the Swift engine made (test Trash root) is put back by the app-hosted Rust engine, which imports Swift's trash-journal.json (the Rust log and its key the Swift engine also wrote are left out, so the import is what restores): file and catalog rows (tags included) restored.

steps.label: row and tag dropped
steps.db: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE file_id=1

steps.label: row and tag back
steps.db: SELECT f.id,f.path_text,t.tag FROM files f JOIN tags t ON t.file_id=f.id WHERE f.id=1

name: swift-written-trash-log-dual-written
description: A Trash batch the Swift engine made (test Trash root) is put back by the app-hosted Rust engine from the signed trash_log.json and log-hmac.key the Swift engine dual-wrote beside trash-journal.json: file and catalog rows (tags included) restored.

steps.label: row and tag dropped
steps.db: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE file_id=1

steps.label: row and tag back
steps.db: SELECT f.id,f.path_text,t.tag FROM files f JOIN tags t ON t.file_id=f.id WHERE f.id=1

name: swift-written-scan-mtimes-chapter
description: A catalog the Swift engine scanned (stored modified times at nanosecond precision) is rescanned by Rust: every stored time stays the same number, a plain rescan re-analyses nothing, and a chapter saved after the first scan is neither marked stale nor loses its revision after a forced rescan. Needs no model.

steps.label: times unchanged by the plain rescan
steps.db: SELECT path_text,size_bytes,modified_at FROM files ORDER BY path_text

steps.label: times unchanged by the forced rescan
steps.db: SELECT path_text,size_bytes,modified_at FROM files ORDER BY path_text

steps.label: the reviewed chapter is current
steps.db: SELECT id,stale,user_edited FROM catalog_chapters

name: swift-written-scan-image-hashes
description: The app-hosted Rust engine rescans a catalog the Swift engine scanned and stores the same CoreGraphics dHash, EXIF camera and capture time for a camera JPEG, a HEIC and a screenshot.

steps.label: same hashes
steps.db: SELECT path_text,phash,camera_model,round(created_at,3) FROM files ORDER BY path_text

name: swift-written-face-queues
description: A merge the Swift engine journaled is undone by Rust from the shared operation log; Rust then splits a person and accepts all of another's suggestions and undoes both, back to the starting rows.

steps.label: back to start
steps.db: SELECT (SELECT person_id FROM face_prints WHERE id=1), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM face_prints WHERE person_id=5), (SELECT person_id FROM face_prints WHERE id=30), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM face_verifications), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_operations WHERE state='undone')

name: swift-written-face-review
description: A suggestion the Swift engine accepted is listed and undone by Rust from the shared operation log; Rust then rejects one and undoes that, back to the starting rows.

steps.label: back to start
steps.db: SELECT (SELECT person_id FROM face_prints WHERE id=3),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM face_identity_constraints),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_operations WHERE state='undone')

steps.label: suggestion back
steps.db: SELECT face_id,person_id,score,reason,runner_up_person_id,runner_up_score,namespace,created_at FROM face_review_candidates WHERE face_id=3

name: swift-written-people-merge
description: A person merge journaled by the Swift engine is offered for undo and undone by the Rust engine: faces, names, representative faces and the verified verdict come back, and a second undo is refused.

steps.label: restored
steps.db: SELECT id,name,title,first_name,is_unknown,representative_face_id,file_count FROM persons ORDER BY id

steps.label: faces
steps.db: SELECT id,person_id FROM face_prints ORDER BY id

steps.label: verdict
steps.db: SELECT person_a,person_b,same_person,vlm_model,face_a,face_b FROM face_verifications

steps.label: undone
steps.db: SELECT state FROM catalog_operations

expect.message: There is nothing to undo for this suggestion.

name: swift-written-restructure-apply
description: Rust reads the undo journal (Swift's headerless restructure_undo.ndjson) and path-moves.ndjson the Swift engine wrote when it applied the respect-stage moves, and undoes them: files, rows and the empty event folders come back, a second undo does nothing, and Rust plans the same moves again.

steps.label: restored in catalog
steps.db: SELECT id,path_text FROM files WHERE id IN (1,5,13,15) ORDER BY id

steps.label: rust second undo is a no-op
rust plans the same moves again

name: swift-written-path-moves-repaired
description: Two renames the Swift engine journaled in path-moves.ndjson (intent lines, no done lines, as a kill before the done line leaves them) while their catalog rows still name the old path are repaired when the Rust engine starts: the rows point at the new paths and the journal is cleared. Derived from the Swift-written restructure fixture: its done lines are dropped and two rows put back to their old paths.
sql: UPDATE files SET path_text='{path:Kyle Baseball Game 9-19-26/Photos/JPEGs/D1.ARW}' WHERE id=13

steps.label: rows repaired at start
steps.db: SELECT id,path_text FROM files WHERE id IN (1,13) ORDER BY id

name: swift-written-mlx-install-record
description: The Rust engine accepts the MLX install the Swift engine recorded (its installed marker and its verified-identity record, which escapes '/' in paths) without a download.

name: swift-written-older-catalog-v20
description: The Rust engine opens a catalog the Swift engine wrote at schema v20 (v0.1.0, the oldest build released) and brings it to v36 with every row intact: files with their sizes, times, hashes and inodes, tags, a person and face, text and its search, the library root, chapters and take scores where that version has them; a rescan then finds nothing to do. Built by shared/scripts/make_older_catalogs.py with the Swift engine's own migrator.

steps.label: migrated to the current version
steps.db: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grdb_migrations

steps.label: files kept
steps.db: SELECT id,path_text,size_bytes,modified_at,kind,extension,has_faces,has_text,lower(hex(content_hash)),file_ref FROM files ORDER BY id

steps.label: tags kept
steps.db: SELECT file_id,tag,source,score FROM tags ORDER BY file_id,tag,source

steps.label: person and face kept
steps.db: SELECT p.id,p.name,p.file_count,f.id,f.file_id,f.person_id FROM persons p JOIN face_prints f ON f.person_id=p.id

steps.label: text kept
steps.db: SELECT file_id,text FROM ocr_text
expect: Quarterly notes from the generated library

steps.label: library root
steps.db: SELECT path,display,kind FROM library_roots

steps.label: chapters
steps.db: SELECT id,file_id,title,user_edited FROM catalog_chapters

steps.label: take quality
steps.db: SELECT file_id,version FROM take_quality

value.text: Quarterly notes from the generated library

steps.label: files unchanged by it
steps.db: SELECT id,path_text,size_bytes,modified_at,kind,extension,has_faces,has_text,lower(hex(content_hash)),file_ref FROM files ORDER BY id
